Former Synagogue and Medieval Jewish Quarter

Synagogue site · Perugia, Italy

Piazzetta della Sinagoga lies within Perugia’s medieval Jewish quarter, near Via Ulisse Rocchi, Via Bartolo and Via Pozzo Campana. Jewish families lived in this area from at least the 13th century, although it was not a formally enclosed ghetto. A synagogue is believed to have been established here during the 14th century. Little remains visibly identifiable today apart from the square’s name and architectural traces associated with the former synagogue. The surrounding streets preserve the memory of one of medieval Umbria’s important Jewish communities.
